capabilities: Show a site icon before external links
Distinguish Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Forms pages by type
Adapt dark logos to dark mode via theme-aware colors
Render icons in Reading view and Live Preview
Toggle editor icons with a single setting
extras: Icons are bundled from Simple Icons (CC0) plus two custom logos, so coverage is limited to a fixed site list; unreleased versions can be tested via BRAT.
intentEvidence: The idea comes from how Asana shows links to external documents.
motivation: The author says the idea comes from how Asana shows links to external documents.
problem: External links in notes all look alike, so you cannot tell which service a link points to without reading the URL.
summary: Adds offline site icons in front of external links, distinguishing services like Google Docs vs Sheets or GitHub vs Slack at a glance.
